instances.held.bareValues: The elements of {base} are plain values, so pick one with [=value] or an index
instances.held.hasFields: The elements of {base} have fields ({names}), so pick one with [field=value] or an index
instances.held.noField: The elements of {base} have no field "{key}" (fields: {names})
instances.held.notScalar: The field {key} of the elements of {base} is not a string, number or boolean, so it cannot be a condition
instances.line.linesFollowed: Rewrote the lines of card {name} to match the elements of {full}
instances.of.connectionsNotArray: connections is an array of lines
instances.of.dataShape: data is an object nested like the shape (the keys are the field names, e.g. {"id": 1, "lines": [{"sku": "A-1"}]})
instances.of.instanceNeeded: Data (instance) needs of (the path of the entity or value that gives its shape, e.g. Schema:Order)
instances.of.notALine: The line of cannot be written in connections. The shape of a data (instance) card is written as a path in the value's key of
instances.of.onlyOnData: of can be written only on data (instance) and table cards (this is {kind})
instances.of.tableNeeded: A table needs of (the path of the entity or value that gives the shape of the data to tabulate, e.g. Schema:Host)
instances.pick.notArray: {base} is not an array, so [ ] cannot pick an element
instances.problem.noShape: The shape (of) is missing (it was removed, or it is not an entity or value)
instances.problem.required: Required in the shape {name}, but it has no value
instances.said.noFieldInShape: {full}.{at}: the shape {name} has no such field
instances.said.ofNeeded: {full}: of is required (the path of the entity or value that gives the shape, e.g. Schema:Order)
instances.said.required: {full}.{at} is required (in progress; required in the shape {name})
instances.strays.noValueAmong: {name} has no value for the field "{missing}" that the shape lacks (there are: {places})
instances.strays.noValueNone: {name} has no value for the field "{missing}" that the shape lacks (there are no values for fields the shape lacks)
instances.strays.onlyDelete: strayFields only deletes ({key} cannot be given a value. To write a value, add the field to the shape and write it in data)
instances.strays.shape: strayFields is null (deletes the values of all fields the shape lacks) or {"<where>": null} (deletes only that place)
instances.write.fieldsNotObject: The document's fields is not an object
instances.write.followedAt: Rewrote the at of a line of {name} to {now}
instances.write.followedFrom: Rewrote the from of a line of {full} to {said}
instances.write.notObject: The value of {full}.{inner} is not an object, so nothing can be written inside it (write {full}.{inner} first)
instances.wrong.noField: The shape has no such field
instances.wrong.notDecimal: Not a decimal number written as text (e.g. "12.50")
instances.wrong.nullNotAllowed: null cannot be written (null is not allowed)
instances.wrong.outOfNoBranch: Cannot be written when {d} is not set
